input_contract.observable: Per-gene protein mutation strings supplied by the competition

lung_point_mutation_proxy.interpretation: Observed protein-variant proxy; excludes ALK/ROS1/NTRK fusion claims

breast_tumor_variant_proxy.interpretation: Observed tumor-variant proxy; not HER2 amplification or germline status

colorectal_tumor_variant_proxy.interpretation: Observed RAS/BRAF/MMR-gene variant proxy; not MSI-H or dMMR status

ovarian_brca_variant_proxy.interpretation: Observed BRCA variant proxy; not hereditary risk or treatment eligibility

bladder_fgfr3_variant_proxy.interpretation: Observed FGFR3 protein-variant proxy; not fusion or overexpression

deferred_capture_items.reason: The competition input does not identify fusion, germline origin, syndrome phenotype, or transcript context

interpretation_limit: These features are mutation proxies for a classification experiment. They do not reproduce clinical biomarker assays, establish cancer causality, diagnose hereditary cancer, or determine treatment eligibility.
